data.gender_notes: Merell is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'merērē', meaning 'the sea', and 'elle', meaning 'goddess' or 'protector'. In Greek mythology, Merell was the goddess of the sea, who protected sailors and fishermen from the wrath of the sea. The name Merell carries the meaning “Sea goddess, protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Merell usually hope their child will grow to embody sea goddess, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Merell total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Merell carries deep cultural roots, as it harkens back to the ancient Greeks who revered the sea as a powerful source of life and livelihood. This name would have been particularly meaningful to those working on or near the sea, as it was believed to offer them the protection and bounty of the sea goddess. Today, the name Merell not only retains a connection to the sea, but also to the courage, independence, and adaptability of those who live and work on the water.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Merell speaks to the protective and nurturing role of the divine in our lives. It serves as a reminder of the power and vastness of the natural world, and of the ultimately benevolent and provident God who governs it. As such, the name Merell is not only a tribute to the strength and resilience of the sea, but also to the grace and lovingkindness of the divine provider who sustains all of creation.
